entries.title: Smoother driver shifts, live admin tracking
entries.summary: This release focuses on the driver experience: shifts end cleanly, deliveries can be returned to dispatch, cancellations notify drivers instantly, and the admin tracking map got a major upgrade.

changes.text: Drivers are no longer stuck on shift because of an old delivery that was assigned but never started.
Drivers now get a text message and an in-app alert the moment dispatch cancels one of their orders.
The admin tracking overview now updates live and shows accurate delivery and mileage counts.
The admin live map now shows each driver's travelled trail, planned route, and links to their order.
Cancelled orders no longer keep drivers from ending their shift.
The driver status no longer flickers between moving and stopped at walking pace.
The delivery photo camera now opens on the first tap.
The keyboard no longer covers the pickup confirmation form.
Pickup signatures are no longer distorted when drawn in full-screen mode.
Driver requests to return a delivery now go to dispatch for review instead of unassigning immediately.
Drivers can now return a delivery to dispatch when they can't complete it, instead of being stuck unable to end their shift.
A finished delivery now shows its Delivered step with a green check instead of "In progress now".
Delivery photo uploads and ending your shift no longer fail late in a shift.
Confirming a pickup or delivery now closes the window right away instead of freezing for a few seconds.
Signatures drawn in the fullscreen pad are no longer lost when you return to the smaller view.
The route line on the live map no longer turns into a scribble after switching tabs and coming back.
Delivery photos now upload reliably from modern phone cameras.
Shift mileage no longer overcounts when GPS signal wobbles.
The driver home screen loads faster without the stats section.
Finishing a delivery now immediately unlocks the End shift button.
Fixed the driver app's bottom bar showing page content through it on iPhone.
Delivery photos and pickup signatures now display correctly in order files.

entries.title: Smarter tracking, smoother pickups
entries.summary: Admins get live control over how driver tracking behaves, and drivers get a friendlier pickup flow: clear map pins, distances in feet and miles, and a pickup confirmation that no longer depends on a signature.

changes.text: Admins can now tune driver tracking (check-in radius, GPS cadence, offline detection, mileage filters) from the tracking dashboard.
Distance hints in the driver app now show feet and miles instead of meters.
Bigger, more reliable signature signing (with a full-screen mode), and drivers can no longer end a shift while a due delivery is still open.
The driver map now shows pickup and drop-off pins, and the "Arrived" button only activates when you're actually near the stop.
Drivers can confirm pickups by recording who handed over the order — a signature is now optional, and a bug that blocked the pickup step is fixed.

entries.title: A smoother, safer driver experience
entries.summary: Drivers get a calmer app with a full route map and faster feedback, pickup signatures are now required everywhere, and staff can undo an accidental delivery start.

changes.text: Updated partner logos for Kasa, Conviva, and Grace Deli, plus a refreshed catering hero image with improved text readability.
Helpdesk and admins can now fix a delivery that was started by mistake, resetting it back to Assigned.
The driver map now shows your full route for the shift, the delivery list can be filtered by day, and buttons respond instantly.
Drivers are now always asked for the vendor signature when picking up an order, no matter which screen they use.
The driver app got a calmer look — clearer dark action buttons and GPS accuracy shown in feet.
Fixed the delivery time appearing twice on the catering order page.
The live tracking map now shows each order's restaurant pickup point, the driver's name and mileage, and clearly marks a driver as offline when their app loses GPS.
Fixed a broken redirect that sent you to a 404 page instead of the sign-in screen when your session expired.
Driver location tracking is steadier — your trail keeps recording after switching apps or tabs, and full mileage is saved when a shift ends.
Drivers now capture the restaurant's signature when they pick up an order, for accountability.
Drivers can now choose their preferred maps app (Google Maps, Apple Maps, or Waze) for navigation, and the Navigate button is easier to find.
Driver location tracking now works on iPhone (Safari), not just Android.
Live driver tracking now records GPS location again during a shift.
Driver app: your live tracking, delivery progress, and proof-of-delivery now stay in sync across every screen, and the map shows the real order number.
Fixed a stuck Connecting indicator on the admin order page, plus clearer driver status labels and tidier empty states.
Proof-of-delivery photos now upload reliably, and if the photo cannot upload you can still finish the delivery and it syncs in the background.
If completing a delivery fails, the proof-of-delivery screen now stays open so you can retry without re-capturing.
The driver app now tells you when a delivery status update fails instead of silently doing nothing.
Drivers can advance deliveries, track location, and end shifts again.

entries.title: A brand-new driver app
entries.summary: This release is all about drivers: the driver app has been redesigned from the ground up for phones, with live shift tracking, a clearer step-by-step delivery flow, and improved reliability when many drivers are on the road at once. Our public pages are also now easier to find in search.

changes.text: The driver home screen's delivery count now always matches the list shown, and the list refreshes automatically.
The driver history screen now shows a friendly retry instead of an error page if data is briefly unavailable.
Driver history and tracking stay reliable when many drivers use the app at once.
Drivers get a clearer delivery detail screen with a step-by-step status timeline and one-tap directions.
The driver app has a refreshed, mobile-first design with live shift tracking, clearer delivery status, and light/dark themes.
Improved SEO metadata, structured data, and sitemap coverage across all public pages.

entries.title: Better order visibility and a smoother address picker
entries.summary: This update brings live driver tracking to more order views, clearer dashboards, and a friendlier way to enter delivery addresses.

changes.text: You can now follow your driver on the map in real time from your order page.
Create on-demand orders directly from your dashboard in just a few steps.
Dashboards now show pending and cancelled orders at a glance, so nothing slips through the cracks.
The address selector is easier to use, especially on your phone.
Smoothed out a few rough edges on the delivery map.
